# SEV-SNP test fixtures

Used by the unit tests in `src/snp.rs`.

## `virtee/`: real AMD evidence

Copied from [virtee/sev](https://github.com/virtee/sev) `tests/certs_data/` at commit
`feaf142ec916c23e7658f088802921177ee290f9`, under the Apache License 2.0 (copy in `virtee/LICENSE`).
They are unmodified.

* `report_milan.hex`: a version 2 SNP attestation report from a Milan host.
* `vcek_milan.der`: the VCEK AMD's KDS issued for that report's chip and reported TCB. It is valid
  until 2030-04-03. KDS still serves a reissued VCEK with the same key for this chip and TCB.
* `vcek_turin.der`: a Turin VCEK, with no matching report. It is used for the Turin chain and its
  extensions (`fmcSPL`, 8-byte hwID).

## `fake/`: test-only chains

Generated by `fake/gen.sh` with throwaway keys, for the negative tests. They have the same shape as
AMD's chains:
* RSA-PSS SHA-384 CA certificates;
* P-384 leaves carrying AMD's TCB and hwID extensions.

The leaf private keys (`*.pk8`) are here so the tests can sign reports. Nothing outside `cargo test`
trusts these certificates.

## AMD roots

The production roots are in `../../../certs/amd/`. They were downloaded from
`https://kdsintf.amd.com/vcek/v1/{Milan,Genoa,Turin}/cert_chain` (ARK and ASK) and `.../vlek/v1/...`
(ASVK). The SHA-256 fingerprints of the DER ARKs are pinned in `src/snp.rs` and match virtee/sev's
built-in copies:

| Product | ARK SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| Milan | `69d063b45344d26a2e94e1f4210de49ef555308287d4c174445c95639a540bcd` |
| Genoa | `4c6598d19c18719c5dfd4a7d335f674e5bfe1d8f800cea2cf270c10d103db2f1` |
| Turin | `1f084161a44bb6d93778a904877d4819cafa5d05ef4193b2ded9dd9c73dd3f6a` |
